name: Radarr
longDescription: Radarr is a movie collection manager for Usenet and BitTorrent users. It monitors your wanted movies, automatically downloads new releases, upgrades existing files when better quality becomes available, and organizes your media library. Optionally deploy a dedicated 2160p instance to keep UHD movies separate with independent quality profiles, root folders, and download management.
description: Movie collection manager with optional dedicated 2160p instance.
